间隔: 直观
Chapter 6: Support vector machines · 6.1 Margins: intuition

Page 61

This set of notes presents the Support Vector Machine (SVM) learning algorithm. SVMs are among the best (and many believe are indeed the best) “off-the-shelf” supervised learning algorithms. To tell the SVM story, we'll need to first talk about margins and the idea of separating data with a large “gap.” Next, we'll talk about the optimal margin classifier, which will lead us into a digression on Lagrange duality. We'll also see kernels, which give a way to apply SVMs efficiently in very high dimensional (such as infinite-dimensional) feature spaces, and finally, we'll close off the story with the SMO algorithm, which gives an efficient implementation of SVMs.

本章讲支持向量机 (SVM), 它是最好的「开箱即用」监督学习算法之一 (很多人认为就是最好的). 路线: 先讲间隔和「用一条宽缝把数据分开」的想法; 再讲最优间隔分类器, 由此岔开去讲拉格朗日对偶; 用核把 SVM 搬到很高维 (甚至无穷维) 的特征空间; 最后讲高效实现 SVM 的 SMO 算法. 这里说的「开箱即用」指不需要太多调参和领域知识就能得到很好的结果, 这是 2000 年代 SVM 流行的主要原因.

讲义问题: 这一段说本章会讲核, 但当前版本的第 6 章里没有讲核的小节: 核方法已经挪到第 5 章, 本章只在 6.6 末尾提到对偶形式只依赖内积. 读的时候把「核」那部分对应到第 5 章.

Page 61–62

Consider logistic regression, where the probability p(y = 1|x; θ) is modeled by hθ​(x)=g(θTx). We then predict “1” on an input x if and only if hθ​(x)≥0.5, or equivalently, if and only if θTx≥0. Consider a positive training example (y = 1). The larger θTx is, the larger also is hθ​(x)=p(y=1∣x;θ), and thus also the higher our degree of “confidence” that the label is 1. Thus, informally we can think of our prediction as being very confident that y = 1 if θTx≫0. Similarly, we think of logistic regression as confidently predicting y = 0, if θTx≪0. Given a training set, again informally it seems that we'd have found a good fit to the training data if we can find θ so that θTx(i)≫0 whenever y(i)=1, and θTx(i)≪0 whenever y(i)=0, since this would reflect a very confident (and correct) set of classifications for all the training examples. This seems to be a nice goal to aim for, and we'll soon formalize this idea using the notion of functional margins.

第一种直观来自逻辑回归: θTx≥0 时预测 1. θTx 越大, hθ​(x) 越接近 1, 我们越有把握标签是 1; θTx≫0 时非常有把握. 因此一个好的拟合应当让正样本的 θTx(i) 远大于 0、负样本的远小于 0: 不只是分对, 而且分得有把握. 后面用函数间隔把这个想法形式化.

逻辑回归其实已经在追求这一点: 它的损失 log(1+e−yθTx) (用 ±1 标签写) 在 yθTx 越大时越小, 但永远不为 0, 所以会无止境地把所有点往远处推. SVM 只关心离边界最近的那些点, 一旦间隔足够就不再理会其余样本, 这是两者的根本区别.

Page 62

For a different type of intuition, consider the following figure, in which x's represent positive training examples, o's denote negative training examples, a decision boundary (this is the line given by the equation θTx=0, and is also called the separating hyperplane) is also shown, and three points have also been labeled A, B and C.

Notice that the point A is very far from the decision boundary. If we are asked to make a prediction for the value of y at A, it seems we should be quite confident that y = 1 there. Conversely, the point C is very close to the decision boundary, and while it's on the side of the decision boundary on which we would predict y = 1, it seems likely that just a small change to the decision boundary could easily have caused out prediction to be y = 0. Hence, we're much more confident about our prediction at A than at C. The point B lies in-between these two cases, and more broadly, we see that if a point is far from the separating hyperplane, then we may be significantly more confident in our predictions. Again, informally we think it would be nice if, given a training set, we manage to find a decision boundary that allows us to make all correct and confident (meaning far from the decision boundary) predictions on the training examples. We'll formalize this later using the notion of geometric margins.

第二种直观是几何的: 决策边界 θTx=0 也叫分离超平面. 点 A 离边界很远, 预测它为正类很有把握; 点 C 紧贴边界, 边界稍一移动预测就会翻转, 把握很小; B 居中. 所以离超平面越远, 预测越可信. 理想的边界应让所有训练样本都分对, 而且都离边界远. 后面用几何间隔形式化. 两种直观的区别: 函数间隔看 θTx 的数值, 几何间隔看真实的距离.

为什么离边界远的边界更好? 测试样本与训练样本相似但不完全相同, 可以想象成在训练点附近有小的扰动. 若每个训练点周围都有一圈宽度为 γ 的「安全区」不碰到边界, 那么扰动小于 γ 的测试点都会被分对. 间隔越大, 容许的扰动越大, 泛化越好 (第 8 章会从理论上讨论泛化).

讲义笔误: "could easily have caused out prediction" 中 out 应为 our.

记号
6.2 Notation (option reading)

Page 63

To make our discussion of SVMs easier, we'll first need to introduce a new notation for talking about classification. We will be considering a linear classifier for a binary classification problem with labels y and features x. From now, we'll use y ∈ {−1, 1} (instead of {0, 1}) to denote the class labels. Also, rather than parameterizing our linear classifier with the vector θ, we will use parameters w, b, and write our classifier as

hw,b​(x)=g(wTx+b).

Here, g(z) = 1 if z ≥ 0, and g(z) = −1 otherwise. This “w, b” notation allows us to explicitly treat the intercept term b separately from the other parameters. (We also drop the convention we had previously of letting x0​=1 be an extra coordinate in the input feature vector.) Thus, b takes the role of what was previously θ0​, and w takes the role of [θ1​…θd​]T.

Note also that, from our definition of g above, our classifier will directly predict either 1 or −1 (cf. the perceptron algorithm), without first going through the intermediate step of estimating p(y = 1) (which is what logistic regression does).

新记号: 标签改用 y ∈ {−1, 1}; 参数拆成权重 w 和截距 b, 分类器 hw,b​(x)=g(wTx+b), g 是符号函数 (≥ 0 取 1, 否则取 −1). 不再用 x0​=1 的约定, b 相当于原来的 θ0​. 截距单独拿出来是因为后面它的地位与 w 不同: 间隔里要除以 ∥w∥, 而 b 不进这个范数. 与感知机一样, 分类器直接输出 ±1, 不估计概率. 用 ±1 的好处是「分对」可以统一写成 y(wTx+b)>0.

易错: 本章的 g 是硬阈值的符号函数, 不是第 2 章的 sigmoid, 也就是说 SVM 本身不输出概率. 需要概率时, 要在 SVM 的输出 wTx+b 上再拟合一个 sigmoid (Platt scaling), 这是另一个话题.

讲义笔误: 6.2–6.4、6.6 的标题都写 "(option reading)", 应为 "(optional reading)" (6.5、6.7、6.8 写对了).

函数间隔与几何间隔
6.3 Functional and geometric margins (option reading)

Page 63

Let's formalize the notions of the functional and geometric margins. Given a training example (x(i),y(i)), we define the functional margin of (w, b) with respect to the training example as

γ^​(i)=y(i)(wTx(i)+b).

Note that if y(i)=1, then for the functional margin to be large (i.e., for our prediction to be confident and correct), we need wTx(i)+b to be a large positive number. Conversely, if y(i)=−1, then for the functional margin to be large, we need wTx(i)+b to be a large negative number. Moreover, if y(i)(wTx(i)+b)>0, then our prediction on this example is correct. (Check this yourself.) Hence, a large functional margin represents a confident and a correct prediction.

函数间隔 γ^​(i)=y(i)(wTx(i)+b): 乘上标签后, 正类要求 wTx+b 是大正数, 负类要求是大负数, 两种情况统一成「函数间隔大». 函数间隔 > 0 等价于分对: y = 1 时 wTx+b>0 就预测 1; y = −1 时 wTx+b<0 就预测 −1. 所以函数间隔大 = 分对且有把握.

与感知机的联系: 感知机的更新条件「样本被分错」就是函数间隔 ≤ 0; 感知机只要求所有函数间隔 > 0, 找到任意一个能分开数据的超平面就停下, 结果依赖于样本的顺序和初始值. SVM 进一步要求「最小间隔最大», 在所有可分的超平面中选出唯一的一个.

Page 63–64

For a linear classifier with the choice of g given above (taking values in {−1, 1}), there's one property of the functional margin that makes it not a very good measure of confidence, however. Given our choice of g, we note that if we replace w with 2w and b with 2b, then since g(wTx+b)=g(2wTx+2b), this would not change hw,b​(x) at all. I.e., g, and hence also hw,b​(x), depends only on the sign, but not on the magnitude, of wTx+b. However, replacing (w, b) with (2w, 2b) also results in multiplying our functional margin by a factor of 2. Thus, it seems that by exploiting our freedom to scale w and b, we can make the functional margin arbitrarily large without really changing anything meaningful. Intuitively, it might therefore make sense to impose some sort of normalization condition such as that ∥w∥2​=1; i.e., we might replace (w, b) with (w/∥w∥2​,b/∥w∥2​), and instead consider the functional margin of (w/∥w∥2​,b/∥w∥2​). We'll come back to this later.

Given a training set S={(x(i),y(i));i=1,…,n}, we also define the function margin of (w, b) with respect to S as the smallest of the functional margins of the individual training examples. Denoted by γ^​, this can therefore be written:

γ^​=i=1,…,nmin​γ^​(i).

函数间隔的毛病: 把 (w, b) 换成 (2w, 2b), 分类器完全不变 (只看符号), 函数间隔却翻倍. 只要放大参数, 函数间隔可以任意大, 却没有任何实际意义. 所以它不是好的置信度量, 需要某种归一化, 例如要求 ∥w∥=1. 训练集上的函数间隔定义为所有样本中最小的那个: 关注最没把握的样本.

讲义笔误: "we also define the function margin of (w, b) with respect to S" 中 function 应为 functional.

Page 64

Next, let's talk about geometric margins. Consider the picture below:

The decision boundary corresponding to (w, b) is shown, along with the vector w. Note that w is orthogonal (at 90°) to the separating hyperplane. (You should convince yourself that this must be the case.) Consider the point at A, which represents the input x(i) of some training example with label y(i)=1. Its distance to the decision boundary, γ(i), is given by the line segment AB.

How can we find the value of γ(i)? Well, w/∥w∥ is a unit-length vector pointing in the same direction as w. Since A represents x(i), we therefore find that the point B is given by x(i)−γ(i)⋅w/∥w∥. But this point lies on the decision boundary, and all points x on the decision boundary satisfy the equation wTx+b=0. Hence,

wT(x(i)−γ(i)∥w∥w​)+b=0.

几何间隔是点到决策边界的真实距离. w 垂直于超平面: 超平面上任意两点 x1​,x2​ 都满足 wTx+b=0, 相减得 wT(x1​−x2​)=0, 即 w 与超平面内的任何方向都正交. 求 A 到边界的距离 γ(i): 从 A 沿单位法向量 w/∥w∥ 反方向走 γ(i) 就到达垂足 B, 而 B 在边界上, 代入边界方程即可解出距离.

距离公式的另一种推导: 点 x 到超平面 wTx+b=0 的距离, 就是从超平面上任一点 x0​ 指向 x 的向量在单位法向量 w/∥w∥ 上的投影长度: wT(x−x0​)/∥w∥=(wTx+b)/∥w∥, 因为 wTx0​=−b. 这就是中学的点到直线距离公式 ∣Ax+By+C∣/A2+B2​ 在高维的推广 (去掉绝对值, 保留符号表示在哪一侧).

Page 65

Solving for γ(i) yields

γ(i)​=∥w∥wTx(i)+b​=(∥w∥w​)Tx(i)+∥w∥b​.​

This was worked out for the case of a positive training example at A in the figure, where being on the “positive” side of the decision boundary is good. More generally, we define the geometric margin of (w, b) with respect to a training example (x(i),y(i)) to be

γ(i)=y(i)((∥w∥w​)Tx(i)+∥w∥b​).

Note that if ∥w∥=1, then the functional margin equals the geometric margin—this thus gives us a way of relating these two different notions of margin. Also, the geometric margin is invariant to rescaling of the parameters; i.e., if we replace w with 2w and b with 2b, then the geometric margin does not change. This will in fact come in handy later. Specifically, because of this invariance to the scaling of the parameters, when trying to fit w and b to training data, we can impose an arbitrary scaling constraint on w without changing anything important; for instance, we can demand that ∥w∥=1, or ∣w1​∣=5, or ∣w1​+b∣+∣w2​∣=2, and any of these can be satisfied simply by rescaling w and b.

Finally, given a training set S={(x(i),y(i));i=1,…,n}, we also define the geometric margin of (w, b) with respect to S to be the smallest of the geometric margins on the individual training examples: γ=mini=1,…,n​γ(i).

解得 γ(i)=(wTx(i)+b)/∥w∥. 对负样本, 在「负的一侧」才是好的, 所以一般地乘上标签: 几何间隔 = y(i)(wTx(i)+b)/∥w∥ = 函数间隔 ÷ ∥w∥. 因此 ∥w∥=1 时两者相等. 几何间隔对参数缩放不变 (分子分母同乘一个数), 这带来一个重要的自由: 可以对 (w, b) 加任意一个缩放约束而不改变问题本身, 下一节正是利用这一点把问题化简. 训练集上的几何间隔同样取所有样本中最小的.

例子 (自编, 用 Python 核对): w = (3, 4), b = −5, 点 x = (3, 1), 标签 y = 1. 函数间隔 = 1 × (9 + 4 − 5) = 8; ∥w∥=5, 几何间隔 = 8/5 = 1.6. 把参数换成 (6, 8)、−10, 函数间隔变成 16, 几何间隔仍是 16/10 = 1.6. 点 (0, 0) 若标签为 1, 函数间隔为 −5 < 0, 被分错; 几何间隔 −1 表示它在错误一侧、离边界距离 1.

最优间隔分类器
6.4 The optimal margin classifier (option reading)

Page 65–66

Given a training set, it seems from our previous discussion that a natural desideratum is to try to find a decision boundary that maximizes the (geometric) margin, since this would reflect a very confident set of predictions on the training set and a good “fit” to the training data. Specifically, this will result in a classifier that separates the positive and the negative training examples with a “gap” (geometric margin).

For now, we will assume that we are given a training set that is linearly separable; i.e., that it is possible to separate the positive and negative examples using some separating hyperplane. How will we find the one that achieves the maximum geometric margin? We can pose the following optimization problem:

γ,w,bmax​s.t.​γy(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥γ,i=1,…,n∥w∥=1.​

I.e., we want to maximize γ, subject to each training example having functional margin at least γ. The ∥w∥=1 constraint moreover ensures that the functional margin equals to the geometric margin, so we are also guaranteed that all the geometric margins are at least γ. Thus, solving this problem will result in (w, b) with the largest possible geometric margin with respect to the training set.

目标: 找使训练集几何间隔最大的决策边界, 让正负两类之间留出最宽的「缝». 先假设数据线性可分. 第一种写法: 最大化 γ, 要求每个样本的函数间隔 ≥ γ, 同时 ∥w∥=1 让函数间隔等于几何间隔. 解出来就是最大几何间隔的 (w, b). 在所有能分开数据的直线中, 选「离两类最近点都最远」的那一条.

Page 66

If we could solve the optimization problem above, we'd be done. But the “∥w∥=1” constraint is a nasty (non-convex) one, and this problem certainly isn't in any format that we can plug into standard optimization software to solve. So, let's try transforming the problem into a nicer one. Consider:

γ^​,w,bmax​s.t.​∥w∥γ^​​y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥γ^​,i=1,…,n​

Here, we're going to maximize γ^​/∥w∥, subject to the functional margins all being at least γ^​. Since the geometric and functional margins are related by γ=γ^​/∥w∥, this will give us the answer we want. Moreover, we've gotten rid of the constraint ∥w∥=1 that we didn't like. The downside is that we now have a nasty (again, non-convex) objective ∥w∥γ^​​ function; and, we still don't have any off-the-shelf software that can solve this form of an optimization problem.

问题在于 ∥w∥=1 不是凸约束 (单位球面不是凸集: 两个单位向量的中点长度小于 1), 标准优化软件处理不了. 第二种写法: 去掉这个约束, 改为最大化函数间隔除以 ∥w∥, 即直接最大化几何间隔. 约束变好了, 但目标 γ^​/∥w∥ 又不是凹的, 仍然难解. 问题在一步步化简.

Page 66–67

Let's keep going. Recall our earlier discussion that we can add an arbitrary scaling constraint on w and b without changing anything. This is the key idea we'll use now. We will introduce the scaling constraint that the functional margin of w, b with respect to the training set must be 1: γ^​=1.

Since multiplying w and b by some constant results in the functional margin being multiplied by that same constant, this is indeed a scaling constraint, and can be satisfied by rescaling w, b. Plugging this into our problem above, and noting that maximizing γ^​/∥w∥=1/∥w∥ is the same thing as minimizing ∥w∥2, we now have the following optimization problem:

w,bmin​s.t.​21​∥w∥2y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥1,i=1,…,n​

We've now transformed the problem into a form that can be efficiently solved. The above is an optimization problem with a convex quadratic objective and only linear constraints. Its solution gives us the optimal margin classifier. This optimization problem can be solved using commercial quadratic programming (QP) code.

(Footnote 1) You may be familiar with linear programming, which solves optimization problems that have linear objectives and linear constraints. QP software is also widely available, which allows convex quadratic objectives and linear constraints.

关键一步: 利用缩放自由, 规定训练集的函数间隔 γ^​=1 (总可以通过缩放 w、b 做到). 于是目标变成最大化 1/∥w∥, 等价于最小化 21​∥w∥2 (加 1/2 和平方只是为了求导方便, 最优解不变). 得到的问题目标是凸二次函数、约束是线性的, 称为二次规划 (QP), 可以高效求解, 解就是最优间隔分类器. 几何意义: 最近的样本满足 y(wTx+b)=1, 两类最近点之间的「缝」宽度是 2/∥w∥, 最小化 ∥w∥ 就是把缝撑到最宽.

缝宽为什么是 2/∥w∥: 两条边界 wTx+b=1 和 wTx+b=−1 是平行超平面, 它们到决策边界 wTx+b=0 的距离由上节的公式都是 1/∥w∥, 所以两者相距 2/∥w∥. 硬间隔 SVM 的三步化简可以总结为: 「最大化最近点的距离」→「固定最近点的函数间隔为 1」→「最小化 ∥w∥」. 每一步都没有改变最优的决策边界, 只是换了参数化方式, 从一个非凸问题变成了凸二次规划.

讲义笔误: 第 66 页 "Since the geometric and functional margins are related by γ=γ^​/∥w∣" 分母少了一条竖线, 应为 ∥w∥.

Page 67

While we could call the problem solved here, what we will instead do is make a digression to talk about Lagrange duality. This will lead us to our optimization problem's dual form, which will play a key role in allowing us to use kernels to get optimal margin classifiers to work efficiently in very high dimensional spaces. The dual form will also allow us to derive an efficient algorithm for solving the above optimization problem that will typically do much better than generic QP software.

问题其实已经可以交给 QP 软件解决, 但讲义要岔开去讲拉格朗日对偶, 原因有二: ① 对偶形式只依赖样本之间的内积, 因此可以用核, 让最优间隔分类器在很高维的空间里高效工作; ② 由对偶形式可以推出专门的高效算法 (SMO), 通常比通用的 QP 软件快得多.

拉格朗日对偶
6.5 Lagrange duality (optional reading)

Page 67–68

Let's temporarily put aside SVMs and maximum margin classifiers, and talk about solving constrained optimization problems. Consider a problem of the following form:

wmin​s.t.​f(w)hi​(w)=0,i=1,…,l.​

Some of you may recall how the method of Lagrange multipliers can be used to solve it. (Don't worry if you haven't seen it before.) In this method, we define the Lagrangian to be

L(w,β)=f(w)+i=1∑l​βi​hi​(w)

Here, the βi​'s are called the Lagrange multipliers. We would then find and set L's partial derivatives to zero:

∂wi​∂L​=0;∂βi​∂L​=0,

and solve for w and β.

先暂时放下 SVM, 讲带约束的优化. 只有等式约束 hi​(w)=0 时, 用拉格朗日乘子法: 构造拉格朗日函数 L(w,β)=f(w)+∑i​βi​hi​(w), βi​ 叫拉格朗日乘子, 令它对 w 和 β 的偏导都为 0 再解方程组. 对 βi​ 求偏导为 0 正好就是约束 hi​(w)=0 本身; 对 w 求偏导为 0 表示在最优点 f 的梯度是约束梯度的线性组合 (目标的下降方向都被约束挡住了).

不等式约束为什么要求 αi​≥0: 等式约束的乘子可正可负, 因为违反 hi​=0 的方向有两个. 不等式约束 gi​≤0 只有一个违反方向 (gi​>0), 乘子要非负, 才能保证 αi​gi​ 在违反时变成正的「惩罚», 在满足时不为正. 这也是下面 θP​ 能把约束变成「可行为 f、不可行为 ∞」的原因. 可以把 αi​ 想成违反第 i 个约束时每单位要付的罚金, 对偶问题就是对手在挑最狠的罚金, 而强对偶说明在凸问题里, 最狠的罚金恰好让无约束最优点落在可行域上.

小例子: 在直线 w1​+w2​=1 上最小化 w12​+w22​. L=w12​+w22​+β(w1​+w2​−1); 偏导: 2w1​+β=0, 2w2​+β=0, w1​+w2​=1. 解得 w1​=w2​=1/2, β = −1, 最小值 1/2, 即原点到这条直线的距离的平方.

Page 68

In this section, we will generalize this to constrained optimization problems in which we may have inequality as well as equality constraints. Due to time constraints, we won't really be able to do the theory of Lagrange duality justice in this class, but we will give the main ideas and results, which we will then apply to our optimal margin classifier's optimization problem.

Consider the following, which we'll call the primal optimization problem:

wmin​s.t.​f(w)gi​(w)≤0,i=1,…,khi​(w)=0,i=1,…,l.​

To solve it, we start by defining the generalized Lagrangian

L(w,α,β)=f(w)​+i=1∑k​αi​gi​(w)+i=1∑l​βi​hi​(w).​

Here, the αi​'s and βi​'s are the Lagrange multipliers.

(Footnote 2) Readers interested in learning more about this topic are encouraged to read, e.g., R. T. Rockarfeller (1970), Convex Analysis, Princeton University Press.

推广到同时有不等式约束 gi​(w)≤0 和等式约束 hi​(w)=0 的原问题. 构造广义拉格朗日函数, 不等式约束的乘子记作 αi​, 等式约束的记作 βi​. 讲义说课上时间有限, 只讲主要思想和结论, 不做完整的理论.

讲义笔误: 脚注里的作者名 "Rockarfeller" 应为 Rockafellar (R. T. Rockafellar, 《Convex Analysis》的作者).

Page 68–69

Consider the quantity

θP​(w)=α,β:αi​≥0max​L(w,α,β).

Here, the “P” subscript stands for “primal.” Let some w be given. If w violates any of the primal constraints (i.e., if either gi​(w)>0 or hi​(w)=0 for some i), then you should be able to verify that

​θP​(w)=α,β:αi​≥0max​f(w)+i=1∑k​αi​gi​(w)+i=1∑l​βi​hi​(w)(6.1)=∞.(6.2)​

Conversely, if the constraints are indeed satisfied for a particular value of w, then θP​(w)=f(w). Hence,

θP​(w)=⎩⎨⎧​f(w)∞​if w satisfiesprimal constraintsotherwise.​

Thus, θP​ takes the same value as the objective in our problem for all values of w that satisfies the primal constraints, and is positive infinity if the constraints are violated. Hence, if we consider the minimization problem

wmin​θP​(w)=wmin​α,β:αi​≥0max​L(w,α,β),​

we see that it is the same problem (i.e., and has the same solutions as) our original, primal problem. For later use, we also define the optimal value of the objective to be p∗=minw​θP​(w); we call this the value of the primal problem.

定义 θP​(w): 固定 w, 对乘子 (要求 αi​≥0) 取拉格朗日函数的最大值. 若 w 违反某个约束: gi​(w)>0 时让 αi​→∞, hi​(w)=0 时让 βi​ 取同号趋于无穷, 最大值都是 ∞. 若 w 满足全部约束: αi​gi​(w)≤0, 最大值在 αi​gi​=0 处取到, hi​=0 使 β 项为 0, 所以等于 f(w). 于是 θP​ 就是「可行时为 f, 不可行时为 ∞」的函数, 带约束的原问题被写成了无约束的 minw​maxα,β​L, 最优值记作 p∗.

Page 69

Now, let's look at a slightly different problem. We define

θD​(α,β)=wmin​L(w,α,β).

Here, the “D” subscript stands for “dual.” Note also that whereas in the definition of θP​ we were optimizing (maximizing) with respect to α, β, here we are minimizing with respect to w.

We can now pose the dual optimization problem:

​α,β:αi​≥0max​θD​(α,β)=α,β:αi​≥0max​wmin​L(w,α,β).​

This is exactly the same as our primal problem shown above, except that the order of the “max” and the “min” are now exchanged. We also define the optimal value of the dual problem's objective to be d∗=maxα,β:αi​≥0​θD​(w).

How are the primal and the dual problems related? It can easily be shown that

d∗​=α,β:αi​≥0max​wmin​L(w,α,β)≤wmin​α,β:αi​≥0max​L(w,α,β)=p∗.​

(You should convince yourself of this; this follows from the “max min” of a function always being less than or equal to the “min max.”) However, under certain conditions, we will have d∗=p∗, so that we can solve the dual problem in lieu of the primal problem. Let's see what these conditions are.

对偶问题: 把 min 和 max 的次序交换. 先对 w 求最小得 θD​(α,β), 再对乘子求最大, 最优值记作 d∗. 总有 d∗≤p∗ (弱对偶): 对任意 α≥0 和任意可行的 w, θD​(α,β)≤L(w,α,β)≤f(w) (后一个不等号因为 αi​gi​≤0、hi​=0); 左边取最大、右边取最小仍成立. 一般的「max min ≤ min max」也是同样的道理. 在一定条件下等号成立 (强对偶), 就可以改解对偶问题.

一维例子 (自编): 最小化 f(w)=w2, 约束 g(w)=1−w≤0 (即 w ≥ 1). 原问题显然 w∗=1, p∗=1. 拉格朗日函数 L=w2+α(1−w). 对 w 求最小: 2w−α=0, w = α/2, 得 θD​(α)=α−α2/4. 对 α ≥ 0 求最大: α = 2, d∗=1=p∗, 强对偶成立. KKT: α∗=2>0, 所以约束必须取等号, 确实 w∗=1 在边界上. 若把约束换成 w ≥ −1, 无约束最优点 0 已经可行, 约束不起作用, 对偶会给出 α∗=0: θD​=−α−α2/4, 在 α = 0 取最大.

讲义笔误: "d∗=maxα,β​θD​(w)" 中自变量写错了: θD​ 是乘子的函数, 应为 θD​(α,β).

Suppose f and the gi​'s are convex, and the hi​'s are affine. Suppose further that the constraints gi​ are (strictly) feasible; this means that there exists some w so that gi​(w)<0 for all i.

Under our above assumptions, there must exist w∗,α∗,β∗ so that w∗ is the solution to the primal problem, α∗,β∗ are the solution to the dual problem, and moreover p∗=d∗=L(w∗,α∗,β∗). Moreover, w∗,α∗ and β∗ satisfy the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, which are as follows:

∂wi​∂​L(w∗,α∗,β∗)∂βi​∂​L(w∗,α∗,β∗)αi∗​gi​(w∗)gi​(w∗)α∗​=0,i=1,…,d(6.3)=0,i=1,…,l(6.4)=0,i=1,…,k(6.5)≤0,i=1,…,k(6.6)≥0,i=1,…,k(6.7)​

Moreover, if some w∗,α∗,β∗ satisfy the KKT conditions, then it is also a solution to the primal and dual problems.

(Footnote 3) When f has a Hessian, then it is convex if and only if the Hessian is positive semi-definite. For instance, f(w)=wTw is convex; similarly, all linear (and affine) functions are also convex. … (Footnote 4) I.e., there exists ai​,bi​, so that hi​(w)=aiT​w+bi​. “Affine” means the same thing as linear, except that we also allow the extra intercept term bi​.

强对偶的条件: f 和各 gi​ 是凸函数, hi​ 是仿射函数 (线性加常数), 并且不等式约束严格可行 (存在一点使所有 gi​<0, 这叫 Slater 条件). 这时原问题解 w∗ 与对偶问题解 α∗,β∗ 存在, p∗=d∗, 并满足 KKT 条件: ① 拉格朗日函数对 w 的梯度为 0 (平稳性); ② 等式约束成立; ③ αi∗​gi​(w∗)=0 (互补松弛); ④ 不等式约束成立; ⑤ 乘子非负. 反过来, 满足 KKT 条件的点也是两个问题的解. 脚注: 有 Hessian 时凸 ⇔ Hessian 半正定; 仿射函数就是「线性 + 截距».

为什么要绕到对偶问题: 原问题的变量是 d 维的 w (映射到特征空间后可能是无穷维), 对偶问题的变量是 n 个乘子; 更重要的是对偶问题里数据只以内积出现, 可以换成核.

讲义问题: ① (6.7) 写成 "α∗≥0, i = 1, …, k", 少了下标, 应为 αi∗​≥0. ② PDF 第 70 页 "Moreover, if some w*, α*, β* satisfy the KKT conditions, then it is also a solution to the primal and dual problems." 这一句的前半截排版出错, 被缩成极小的字压在下一行上, 读起来像缺字; 完整句子如本卡片所录.

Page 70

We draw attention to Equation (6.5), which is called the KKT dual complementarity condition. Specifically, it implies that if αi∗​>0, then gi​(w∗)=0. (I.e., the “gi​(w)≤0” constraint is active, meaning it holds with equality rather than with inequality.) Later on, this will be key for showing that the SVM has only a small number of “support vectors”; the KKT dual complementarity condition will also give us our convergence test when we talk about the SMO algorithm.

重点是 (6.5) 对偶互补条件 αi∗​gi​(w∗)=0: 两个因子至少一个为 0. 若乘子 αi∗​>0, 约束必须取等号, 称为起作用 (active) 的约束; 反过来, 约束不取等号 (有富余) 时乘子必为 0. 直观上, 没有「顶到」边界的约束对最优解没有影响, 它的乘子 (可以理解为约束的「价格」) 就是 0. 这一条后面推出「SVM 只有少数支持向量», 也是 SMO 的收敛判据.

最优间隔分类器的对偶形式
6.6 Optimal margin classifiers: the dual form (option reading)

Note: The equivalence of optimization problem (6.8) and the optimization problem (6.12), and the relationship between the primary and dual variables in equation (6.10) are the most important take home messages of this section.

Previously, we posed the following (primal) optimization problem for finding the optimal margin classifier:

w,bmin​s.t.​21​∥w∥2(6.8)y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥1,i=1,…,n​

We can write the constraints as

gi​(w)=−y(i)(wTx(i)+b)+1≤0.

We have one such constraint for each training example. Note that from the KKT dual complementarity condition, we will have αi​>0 only for the training examples that have functional margin exactly equal to one (i.e., the ones corresponding to constraints that hold with equality, gi​(w)=0).

本节最重要的两点: 原问题 (6.8) 与对偶问题 (6.12) 等价; 原变量与对偶变量的关系 (6.10). 把每个样本的约束写成 gi​(w)≤0 的形式. 由对偶互补条件, 只有函数间隔恰好等于 1 的样本 (约束取等号) 才可能有 αi​>0; 其余样本的 αi​=0.

讲义笔误: 提示框里 "primary and dual variables" 应为 primal (原问题的变量).

Page 71

Consider the figure below, in which a maximum margin separating hyperplane is shown by the solid line.

The points with the smallest margins are exactly the ones closest to the decision boundary; here, these are the three points (one negative and two positive examples) that lie on the dashed lines parallel to the decision boundary. Thus, only three of the αi​'s—namely, the ones corresponding to these three training examples—will be non-zero at the optimal solution to our optimization problem. These three points are called the support vectors in this problem. The fact that the number of support vectors can be much smaller than the size the training set will be useful later.

Let's move on. Looking ahead, as we develop the dual form of the problem, one key idea to watch out for is that we'll try to write our algorithm in terms of only the inner product ⟨x(i),x(j)⟩ (think of this as (x(i))Tx(j)) between points in the input feature space. The fact that we can express our algorithm in terms of these inner products will be key when we apply the kernel trick.

读图: 实线是最大间隔超平面, 两条虚线是函数间隔为 1 的位置, 恰好落在虚线上的三个点 (一负两正) 离边界最近. 只有它们的 αi​ 不为 0, 称为支持向量: 决策边界完全由它们「撑起」, 删掉其他任何样本, 解都不变. 支持向量的数目通常远小于训练集大小. 另一个要留意的是: 对偶形式将只用到样本之间的内积 ⟨x(i),x(j)⟩, 这是使用核技巧的关键.

支持向量少意味着什么: 删掉一个非支持向量后重新训练, 解完全不变, 它仍被分对. 所以留一交叉验证的误差不超过「支持向量个数 / n」: 只有删掉支持向量时才可能出错. 支持向量占比小, 本身就是泛化好的一个信号. 反过来, 若训练后发现几乎所有样本都是支持向量 (软间隔下常见于 C 太小或数据噪声大), 模型往往不太好.

When we construct the Lagrangian for our optimization problem we have:

L(w,b,α)=​21​∥w∥2−i=1∑n​αi​[y(i)(wTx(i)+b)−1].(6.9)​

Note that there're only “αi​” but no “βi​” Lagrange multipliers, since the problem has only inequality constraints.

Let's find the dual form of the problem. To do so, we need to first minimize L(w,b,α) with respect to w and b (for fixed α), to get θD​, which we'll do by setting the derivatives of L with respect to w and b to zero. We have:

∇w​L(w,b,α)=w−i=1∑n​αi​y(i)x(i)=0

This implies that

w=i=1∑n​αi​y(i)x(i).(6.10)

As for the derivative with respect to b, we obtain

∂b∂​L(w,b,α)=i=1∑n​αi​y(i)=0.(6.11)

You should also be able to verify that the conditions required for p∗=d∗ and the KKT conditions (Equations 6.3–6.7) to hold are indeed satisfied in our optimization problem. Hence, we can solve the dual in lieu of solving the primal problem. Specifically, in the dual problem above, we have a maximization problem in which the parameters are the αi​'s. We'll talk later about the specific algorithm that we're going to use to solve the dual problem, but if we are indeed able to solve it (i.e., find the α's that maximize W(α) subject to the constraints), then we can use Equation (6.10) to go back and find the optimal w's as a function of the α's. Having found w∗, by considering the primal problem, it is also straightforward to find the optimal value for the intercept term b as

b∗=−21​(​i:y(i)=−1max​w∗Tx(i)+i:y(i)=1min​w∗Tx(i)).(6.13)​

(Check for yourself that this is correct.)

这里强对偶的条件都满足: 目标 21​∥w∥2 凸, 约束是仿射函数 (仿射函数也是凸的), 数据线性可分时把可行的 w 放大一点就严格可行. 所以可以解对偶问题代替原问题: 求出 α 后由 (6.10) 得 w∗. 截距 (6.13): 负类中 w∗Tx 最大的点和正类中最小的点是两侧最靠近边界的支持向量, 边界应在它们正中间, 所以 b 取两者平均值的相反数. 等价地, 任取一个支持向量 i, 由 y(i)(w∗Tx(i)+b)=1 也能解出 b=y(i)−w∗Tx(i).

最小例子 (自编, 用 Python 核对): 两个样本 x(1)=(1,1), y = 1; x(2)=(−1,−1), y = −1. 由 (6.11) 得 α1​=α2​=a. 内积: ⟨x(1),x(1)⟩=⟨x(2),x(2)⟩=2, ⟨x(1),x(2)⟩=−2. 于是 W=2a−21​a2(2+2+2+2)=2a−4a2, 最大点 a = 1/4. 由 (6.10), w = ¼(1, 1) − ¼(−1, −1) = (½, ½); 由 (6.13), b = −(−1 + 1)/2 = 0. 检查: 两点的函数间隔都是 1, 几何间隔 1/∥w∥=2​, 正好是两点距离 22​ 的一半, 边界是两点连线的垂直平分线 x1​+x2​=0. 对偶最优值 W = 1/4 等于原问题最优值 21​∥w∥2=1/4, 强对偶成立.

Page 73

Before moving on, let's also take a more careful look at Equation (6.10), which gives the optimal value of w in terms of (the optimal value of) α. Suppose we've fit our model's parameters to a training set, and now wish to make a prediction at a new point input x. We would then calculate wTx+b, and predict y = 1 if and only if this quantity is bigger than zero. But using (6.10), this quantity can also be written:

wTx+b​=(i=1∑n​αi​y(i)x(i))Tx+b(6.14)=i=1∑n​αi​y(i)⟨x(i),x⟩+b.(6.15)​

Hence, if we've found the αi​'s, in order to make a prediction, we have to calculate a quantity that depends only on the inner product between x and the points in the training set. Moreover, we saw earlier that the αi​'s will all be zero except for the support vectors. Thus, many of the terms in the sum above will be zero, and we really need to find only the inner products between x and the support vectors (of which there is often only a small number) in order calculate (6.15) and make our prediction.

By examining the dual form of the optimization problem, we gained significant insight into the structure of the problem, and were also able to write the entire algorithm in terms of only inner products between input feature vectors. In the next section, we will exploit this property to apply the kernels to our classification problem. The resulting algorithm, support vector machines, will be able to efficiently learn in very high dimensional spaces.

预测时也只需要内积: wTx+b=∑i​αi​y(i)⟨x(i),x⟩+b, 而且只有支持向量的项不为 0, 所以只需算新点与少数支持向量的内积. 换成核: ∑i​αi​y(i)K(x(i),x)+b, 这就是支持向量机, 可以在很高维的特征空间里高效学习. 与第 5 章的核 LMS 相比, 核 SVM 的解是稀疏的 (大多数系数为 0), 预测更快.

例如用高斯核时, 判别函数是 ∑i​αi​y(i)exp(−∥x(i)−x∥2/2σ2)+b: 每个支持向量在自己周围放一个「小山包」(正类为正、负类为负), 新点看哪一类的山包加起来更高. σ 小时山包很窄, 边界可以非常弯曲, 容易过拟合; σ 大时边界接近线性.

讲义问题: ① "in order calculate (6.15)" 漏了 to. ② "In the next section, we will exploit this property to apply the kernels" 与实际不符: 下一节 6.7 讲的是软间隔, 核的内容在第 5 章 (见本章开头的说明).

正则化与线性不可分
6.7 Regularization and the non-separable case (optional reading)

Page 74

The derivation of the SVM as presented so far assumed that the data is linearly separable. While mapping data to a high dimensional feature space via φ does generally increase the likelihood that the data is separable, we can't guarantee that it always will be so. Also, in some cases it is not clear that finding a separating hyperplane is exactly what we'd want to do, since that might be susceptible to outliers. For instance, the left figure below shows an optimal margin classifier, and when a single outlier is added in the upper-left region (right figure), it causes the decision boundary to make a dramatic swing, and the resulting classifier has a much smaller margin.

前面的推导假设数据线性可分. 映射到高维特征空间通常更容易可分, 但不能保证. 而且即使可分, 硬要找分离超平面也未必好, 因为对离群点敏感: 左图是正常的最优间隔分类器; 右图在左上角 (正类区域里) 加了一个负样本, 为了把它也分对, 边界大幅旋转, 间隔变得很小. 一个可能是标注错误的点就改变了整个分类器.

C 的选择: C 和核参数 (如高斯核的 σ) 是 SVM 最主要的两个超参数, 通常在对数网格上 (如 C ∈ {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100}) 用交叉验证一起搜索 (第 9 章). 经验上: 数据噪声大、离群点多时 C 取小; 数据干净时 C 取大. C 太大会像右图那样被个别点牵着走 (过拟合), C 太小则把很多样本都当成可以忽略的违规, 间隔很宽但分类粗糙 (欠拟合).

Page 74

To make the algorithm work for non-linearly separable datasets as well as be less sensitive to outliers, we reformulate our optimization (using ℓ1​ regularization) as follows:

γ,w,bmin​s.t.​21​∥w∥2+Ci=1∑n​ξi​y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥1−ξi​,i=1,…,nξi​≥0,i=1,…,n.​

Thus, examples are now permitted to have (functional) margin less than 1, and if an example has functional margin 1−ξi​ (with ξ > 0), we would pay a cost of the objective function being increased by Cξi​. The parameter C controls the relative weighting between the twin goals of making the ∥w∥2 small (which we saw earlier makes the margin large) and of ensuring that most examples have functional margin at least 1.

软间隔: 给每个样本一个松弛变量 ξi​≥0, 允许它的函数间隔小于 1 (甚至为负, 即分错), 但目标中要付出 Cξi​ 的代价. 因为惩罚的是 ξi​ 之和 (ℓ1​ 范数), 讲义称之为 ℓ1​ 正则化. C 权衡两个目标: ∥w∥2 小 (间隔大) 与大多数样本的函数间隔 ≥ 1. C 很大时接近硬间隔, 几乎不容忍违规; C 小时允许更多样本越界, 换取更宽的间隔, 对离群点更稳健. C 通常用交叉验证选.

回到离群点的例子: 软间隔下那个左上角的点可以付出代价 Cξi​ 留在错误一侧, 而不必让整个边界为它旋转. 当 C → ∞ 时所有 ξi​ 被迫为 0, 退化成硬间隔 (数据不可分时无解).

讲义笔误: 优化变量写成 minγ,w,b​, 但问题里没有 γ, 而松弛变量 ξ 才是要优化的, 应为 minw,b,ξ​.

等价的合页损失写法: 最优时 ξi​ 取能满足约束的最小值 ξi​=max(0,1−y(i)(wTx(i)+b)), 代回去得无约束问题

w,bmin​​21​∥w∥2+Ci=1∑n​max(0,1−y(i)(wTx(i)+b)).​

后一项是合页损失 (hinge loss): 函数间隔 ≥ 1 时损失为 0, 小于 1 时线性增长. 所以软间隔 SVM = 合页损失 + ℓ2​ 正则, 与「逻辑损失 + ℓ2​ 正则」的正则化逻辑回归只差损失函数 (补充讲义合集的 loss-functions 讲义比较了这几种损失). 合页损失在间隔足够大时恰好为 0, 这正是 SVM 解稀疏的原因.

Page 75

As before, we can form the Lagrangian:

​L(w,b,ξ,α,r)=21​wTw+Ci=1∑n​ξi​−i=1∑n​αi​[y(i)(xTw+b)−1+ξi​]−i=1∑n​ri​ξi​.​

Here, the αi​'s and ri​'s are our Lagrange multipliers (constrained to be ≥ 0). We won't go through the derivation of the dual again in detail, but after setting the derivatives with respect to w and b to zero as before, substituting them back in, and simplifying, we obtain the following dual form of the problem:

αmax​s.t.​W(α)=i=1∑n​αi​−21​i,j=1∑n​y(i)y(j)αi​αj​⟨x(i),x(j)⟩0≤αi​≤C,i=1,…,ni=1∑n​αi​y(i)=0,​

拉格朗日函数: 间隔约束的乘子 αi​, 约束 ξi​≥0 的乘子 ri​. 对 w、b 求导与之前相同; 多出来的对 ξi​ 求导: C−αi​−ri​=0, 即 ri​=C−αi​. 由 ri​≥0 得 αi​≤C, 而且代回后所有 ξ 项正好抵消. 所以对偶问题与硬间隔完全一样, 只是 α 多了上界 C (讲义说「不再详细推导」, 漏掉的正是对 ξ 求导这一步).

讲义笔误: 拉格朗日函数中写成 y(i)(xTw+b), x 少了上标, 应为 y(i)(wTx(i)+b).

Page 75

As before, we also have that w can be expressed in terms of the αi​'s as given in Equation (6.10), so that after solving the dual problem, we can continue to use Equation (6.15) to make our predictions. Note that, somewhat surprisingly, in adding ℓ1​ regularization, the only change to the dual problem is that what was originally a constraint that 0≤αi​ has now become 0≤αi​≤C. The calculation for b∗ also has to be modified (Equation 6.13 is no longer valid); see the comments in the next section/Platt's paper.

Also, the KKT dual-complementarity conditions (which in the next section will be useful for testing for the convergence of the SMO algorithm) are:

αi​=0αi​=C0<αi​<C​⇒y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≥1(6.16)⇒y(i)(wTx(i)+b)≤1(6.17)⇒y(i)(wTx(i)+b)=1.(6.18)​

Now, all that remains is to give an algorithm for actually solving the dual problem, which we will do in the next section.

w 仍由 (6.10) 给出, 预测仍用 (6.15). 加入 ℓ1​ 正则后对偶问题唯一的变化是 0≤αi​≤C; 但 b 的公式 (6.13) 不再适用 (此时可能有越界的点), 通常用 0<αi​<C 的支持向量 (正好在间隔边界上) 来算 b. KKT 条件把样本分成三类: ① αi​=0: 在间隔边界之外, 分得很好, 对解没有影响; ② αi​=C: 在间隔边界之内或被分错 (ξi​>0); ③ 0<αi​<C: 正好在间隔边界上. ②③ 都是支持向量.

三条 KKT 条件的来历: 互补条件有两组: αi​[y(i)(wTx(i)+b)−1+ξi​]=0 和 ri​ξi​=(C−αi​)ξi​=0. αi​=0 时 ri​=C>0, 所以 ξi​=0, 约束给出函数间隔 ≥ 1. αi​=C 时第一组要求 函数间隔 = 1−ξi​≤1. 0<αi​<C 时两组都起作用: ξi​=0 且函数间隔 = 1.

SMO 算法
6.8 The SMO algorithm (optional reading) · 6.8.1 Coordinate ascent

Page 75–76

The SMO (sequential minimal optimization) algorithm, due to John Platt, gives an efficient way of solving the dual problem arising from the derivation of the SVM. Partly to motivate the SMO algorithm, and partly because it's interesting in its own right, let's first take another digression to talk about the coordinate ascent algorithm.

Consider trying to solve the unconstrained optimization problem

αmax​W(α1​,α2​,…,αn​).

Here, we think of W as just some function of the parameters αi​'s, and for now ignore any relationship between this problem and SVMs. We've already seen two optimization algorithms, gradient ascent and Newton's method. The new algorithm we're going to consider here is called coordinate ascent:

Loop until convergence: {
    For i = 1, ..., n, {
        α_i := argmax_{α̂_i} W(α_1, ..., α_{i-1}, α̂_i, α_{i+1}, ..., α_n).
    }
}

Thus, in the innermost loop of this algorithm, we will hold all the variables except for some αi​ fixed, and reoptimize W with respect to just the parameter αi​. In the version of this method presented here, the inner-loop reoptimizes the variables in order α1​,α2​,…,αn​,α1​,α2​,…. (A more sophisticated version might choose other orderings; for instance, we may choose the next variable to update according to which one we expect to allow us to make the largest increase in W(α).)

SMO (序列最小优化, John Platt 提出) 是求解 SVM 对偶问题的高效算法. 先讲它的基础坐标上升: 每次只把一个变量 αi​ 当作自由变量, 其余全部固定, 在这一维上把 W 优化到最大; 依次轮换 α1​,…,αn​, 反复进行直到收敛. 更聪明的版本按「预计能让 W 增加最多」的顺序选下一个变量. (讲义的伪代码在这里排成代码块.)

为什么不直接用通用 QP 软件: 对偶问题的 Q 矩阵是 n × n 的稠密矩阵, n = 105 时有 1010 个元素, 存都存不下; 通用 QP 方法每步还要解与 n 同规模的线性方程组. SMO 每次只碰两个变量, 只需要核矩阵的两行 (可以随用随算并缓存), 内存是 O(n), 这使 SVM 在 1990 年代末能处理当时的大数据集.

Page 76–77

When the function W happens to be of such a form that the “arg max” in the inner loop can be performed efficiently, then coordinate ascent can be a fairly efficient algorithm. Here's a picture of coordinate ascent in action:

The ellipses in the figure are the contours of a quadratic function that we want to optimize. Coordinate ascent was initialized at (2, −2), and also plotted in the figure is the path that it took on its way to the global maximum. Notice that on each step, coordinate ascent takes a step that's parallel to one of the axes, since only one variable is being optimized at a time.

若内层的单变量 arg max 能很快算出 (例如 W 是二次函数, 一维最大值有闭式解), 坐标上升就很高效. 读图: 从 (2, −2) 出发, 每一步只动一个坐标, 所以路径是平行于坐标轴的折线, 每一段都停在该方向上的最高点 (与等高线相切处). 等高线是倾斜的椭圆, 两个变量相关时折线会走很多「之」字, 越靠近中心步子越小.

算一个例子 (自编, 用 Python 核对): 最大化 W=−(α12​+α22​−α1​α2​), 最大值在原点. 固定 α2​ 对 α1​ 求导为 0 得 α1​=α2​/2, 同理 α2​=α1​/2. 从 (2, −2) 出发: (−1, −0.5) → (−0.25, −0.125) → (−0.0625, −0.03125) …, 每轮误差缩小为 1/4. 两个变量的耦合 (交叉项系数) 越强, 每轮缩小得越少, 收敛越慢; 没有交叉项时一轮就到达最优.

Page 77–78

We close off the discussion of SVMs by sketching the derivation of the SMO algorithm. Here's the (dual) optimization problem that we want to solve:

αmax​s.t.​W(α)=i=1∑n​αi​−21​i,j=1∑n​y(i)y(j)αi​αj​⟨x(i),x(j)⟩(6.19)0≤αi​≤C,i=1,…,n(6.20)i=1∑n​αi​y(i)=0.(6.21)​

Let's say we have set of αi​'s that satisfy the constraints (6.20-6.21). Now, suppose we want to hold α2​,…,αn​ fixed, and take a coordinate ascent step and reoptimize the objective with respect to α1​. Can we make any progress? The answer is no, because the constraint (6.21) ensures that

α1​y(1)=−i=2∑n​αi​y(i).

Or, by multiplying both sides by y(1), we equivalently have

α1​=−y(1)i=2∑n​αi​y(i).

(This step used the fact that y(1)∈{−1,1}, and hence (y(1))2=1.) Hence, α1​ is exactly determined by the other αi​'s, and if we were to hold α2​,…,αn​ fixed, then we can't make any change to α1​ without violating the constraint (6.21) in the optimization problem.

SVM 的对偶问题 (6.19)–(6.21) 不能直接用坐标上升: 固定其余 n − 1 个变量后, 等式约束 (6.21) 把 α1​ 完全确定了 (两边乘 y(1), 利用 (y(1))2=1), 单独改 α1​ 必然违反约束. 所以每次至少要同时改两个变量.

从几何上看: 等式约束 ∑i​αi​y(i)=0 是 n 维空间里的一个超平面, 可行的 α 只能在这个超平面上移动. 只改一个坐标相当于沿坐标轴移动, 必然离开超平面; 同时改两个坐标, 才能沿着超平面内的一条直线移动 (方向满足 y(1)Δα1​+y(2)Δα2​=0), 这正是下面 (6.22) 那条直线.

Page 78

Thus, if we want to update some subject of the αi​'s, we must update at least two of them simultaneously in order to keep satisfying the constraints. This motivates the SMO algorithm, which simply does the following:

Repeat till convergence {

  1. Select some pair αi​ and αj​ to update next (using a heuristic that tries to pick the two that will allow us to make the biggest progress towards the global maximum).
  2. Reoptimize W(α) with respect to αi​ and αj​, while holding all the other αk​'s (k ≠ i, j) fixed.

}

To test for convergence of this algorithm, we can check whether the KKT conditions (Equations 6.16-6.18) are satisfied to within some tol. Here, tol is the convergence tolerance parameter, and is typically set to around 0.01 to 0.001. (See the paper and pseudocode for details.)

The key reason that SMO is an efficient algorithm is that the update to αi​,αj​ can be computed very efficiently. Let's now briefly sketch the main ideas for deriving the efficient update.

SMO 的做法: 反复 ① 用启发式选一对 αi​,αj​ (选能让目标进步最大的一对); ② 固定其他变量, 只对这两个变量重新优化 W. 收敛判据: 所有样本的 KKT 条件 (6.16)–(6.18) 都在容差 tol 内满足, tol 一般取 0.01 到 0.001. 「最小」指每次优化的子问题已经是最小可能的规模 (两个变量), 而两个变量的子问题有闭式解, 不需要调用 QP 软件, 这是 SMO 快的关键.

讲义笔误: "if we want to update some subject of the αᵢ's" 中 subject 应为 subset.

Page 78–79

Let's say we currently have some setting of the αi​'s that satisfy the constraints (6.20-6.21), and suppose we've decided to hold α3​,…,αn​ fixed, and want to reoptimize W(α1​,α2​,…,αn​) with respect to α1​ and α2​ (subject to the constraints). From (6.21), we require that

α1​y(1)+α2​y(2)=−i=3∑n​αi​y(i).

Since the right hand side is fixed (as we've fixed α3​,…,αn​), we can just let it be denoted by some constant ζ:

α1​y(1)+α2​y(2)=ζ.(6.22)

We can thus picture the constraints on α1​ and α2​ as follows:

From the constraints (6.20), we know that α1​ and α2​ must lie within the box [0, C] × [0, C] shown. Also plotted is the line α1​y(1)+α2​y(2)=ζ, on which we know α1​ and α2​ must lie. Note also that, from these constraints, we know L≤α2​≤H; otherwise, (α1​,α2​) can't simultaneously satisfy both the box and the straight line constraint. In this example, L = 0. But depending on what the line α1​y(1)+α2​y(2)=ζ looks like, this won't always necessarily be the case; but more generally, there will be some lower-bound L and some upper-bound H on the permissible values for α2​ that will ensure that α1​,α2​ lie within the box [0, C] × [0, C].

固定 α3​,…,αn​ 后, 等式约束变成 α1​y(1)+α2​y(2)=ζ (ζ 是常数). 读图: 两个变量必须同时落在方框 [0, C]² 里和这条直线上, 即直线被方框截出的那一段. 把这一段投影到 α2​ 轴上, 得到区间 [L, H]. 图中直线从方框底边穿入, 所以 L = 0; 它从右边 α1​=C 处穿出, 对应的 α2​ 值就是 H.

L 和 H 的一般公式 (Platt 1998 的论文): 若 y(1)=y(2) (直线斜率为 +1): L=max(0,α2​−α1​), H=min(C,C+α2​−α1​). 若 y(1)=y(2) (斜率为 −1): L=max(0,α1​+α2​−C), H=min(C,α1​+α2​). 这里的 α1​,α2​ 是更新前的旧值. 图中的情形是 y(1)=y(2) 且 α1​>α2​, 所以 L = 0.

Page 79

Using Equation (6.22), we can also write α1​ as a function of α2​:

α1​=(ζ−α2​y(2))y(1).

(Check this derivation yourself; we again used the fact that y(1)∈{−1,1} so that (y(1))2=1.) Hence, the objective W(α) can be written

​W(α1​,α2​,…,αn​)=W((ζ−α2​y(2))y(1),α2​,…,αn​).​

Treating α3​,…,αn​ as constants, you should be able to verify that this is just some quadratic function in α2​. I.e., this can also be expressed in the form aα22​+bα2​+c for some appropriate a, b, and c. If we ignore the “box” constraints (6.20) (or, equivalently, that L≤α2​≤H), then we can easily maximize this quadratic function by setting its derivative to zero and solving. We'll let α2new,unclipped​ denote the resulting value of α2​. You should also be able to convince yourself that if we had instead wanted to maximize W with respect to α2​ but subject to the box constraint, then we can find the resulting value optimal simply by taking α2new,unclipped​ and “clipping” it to lie in the [L, H] interval, to get

用直线方程把 α1​ 写成 α2​ 的函数, 代入 W, 其余变量都是常数, W 就变成 α2​ 的一元二次函数 (W 本身是 α 的二次函数, 代入一次式后仍是二次). 先忽略方框约束, 令导数为 0 得到「未剪裁」的最优值 α2new,unclipped​; 再考虑 [L, H] 的约束. 由于这是开口向下的抛物线 (一般情形), 区间上的最大值要么在顶点, 要么在离顶点最近的端点, 所以只需「剪裁」到区间内.

闭式更新公式 (Platt 的论文给出, 讲义没有写出): 记预测误差 Ei​=f(x(i))−y(i), 其中 f(x)=∑k​αk​y(k)K(x(k),x)+b, 再记 η=K11​+K22​−2K12​ (= ∥ϕ(x(1))−ϕ(x(2))∥2≥0), 则

α2new,unclipped​=α2​+ηy(2)(E1​−E2​)​.

直观: 两个样本的误差差得越多, α2​ 改得越多; η 是抛物线的曲率. 剪裁后再由 (6.22) 求 α1new​=α1​+y(1)y(2)(α2​−α2new​). 每一步只需 O(n) 时间更新误差缓存, 这就是 SMO 高效的原因.

Page 80

α2new​=⎩⎨⎧​HuL​if u>Hif L≤u≤Hif u<L​

u=α2new,unclipped​

Finally, having found the α2new​, we can use Equation (6.22) to go back and find the optimal value of α1new​.

There're a couple more details that are quite easy but that we'll leave you to read about yourself in Platt's paper: One is the choice of the heuristics used to select the next αi​,αj​ to update; the other is how to update b as the SMO algorithm is run.

(为了适应窄屏, 笔记把原文三处的 α2new,unclipped​ 简记为 u.) 剪裁规则: 超过 H 取 H, 低于 L 取 L, 否则不变. 求出 α2new​ 后, 由 (6.22) 求 α1new​, 它自动落在 [0, C] 内 (这正是 L、H 的定义保证的). 其余细节见 Platt 的论文: 如何启发式地选下一对变量 (通常先选违反 KKT 条件最严重的样本, 再选使 ∣E1​−E2​∣ 最大的另一个), 以及在迭代中如何更新 b.

整体看 SVM 的求解链条: 原问题 (凸 QP) → 拉格朗日对偶 (只含内积, 可核化) → SMO (每次两个变量, 闭式解 + 剪裁). 实际库 (如 LIBSVM, scikit-learn 的 SVC 底层) 用的就是 SMO 的改进版本.
